articles.insight: The news signifies the impact of continuous release of new models on the pricing of older devices in the technology industry.

articles.title: Apple Watch’s new feature listens to your chats and recaps them
articles.description: The Siri Recap feature is similar to other note-taking apps like Granola.
articles.summary: Apple has introduced Siri Recap, a new feature in the Apple Watch that listens to and recaps conversations in real-time. The feature works similarly to note-taking apps like Granola.
points: The Apple Watch's Siri Recap feature listens in real-typing to conversations and provides summaries.
It functions like other digital assistants, but with a focus on conversation transcriptions and recaps.
Users can review and store these recaps, similar to how they interact with other note-taking apps.
articles.insight: This new Siri Recap feature enhances the convenience of digital assistants by providing quick access to conversations, potentially increasing productivity for users.
